import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    # Bubble sort
    for i in range(n-1):
        for j in range(n-i-1):
            if a[j] > a[j+1]:
                a[j], a[j+1] = a[j+1], a[j]
    # Output the element at index n//2
    print(a[n//2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
